```plato

    // The ease-in (accelerating from rest) shape of a family at normalized
    // time t. Every shape is pinned at f(0) = 0 and f(1) = 1; Back and Elastic
    // deliberately dip below zero on the way.
    EaseIn(family: EasingFamily, t: Number): Number
        => match (family) {
            Quad => t * t;
            Cubic => t * t * t;
            Quart => t * t * t * t;
            Quint => t * t * t * t * t;
            Sine => 1.0 - Angle(t * Number.HalfPi).Cos;
            // 2^(10(t - 1)), pinned to 0 at the start where the power is 2^-10.
            Expo => t <= 0.0 ? 0.0 : 2.0.Pow(10.0 * (t - 1.0));
            Circ => 1.0 - (1.0 - t * t).Sqrt;
            // t^2 ((s + 1) t - s) with the conventional overshoot s = 1.70158,
            // which anticipates about 10% below zero before advancing.
            Back => 2.70158 * t * t * t - 1.70158 * t * t;
            // A growing oscillation that arrives at 1: the conventional
            // one-third-turn period with the endpoints pinned.
            Elastic => t <= 0.0 ? 0.0
                     : t >= 1.0 ? 1.0
                     : -(2.0.Pow(10.0 * t - 10.0))
                       * Angle((t * 10.0 - 10.75) * Number.Tau / 3.0).Sin;
            Bounce => 1.0 - BounceOut(1.0 - t);
        };
```
